items.title: What Does Dell Technologies (DELL) Push Into Disaggregated Private Cloud Mean?
items.summary: Dell Technologies (NYSE: DELL) is promoting disaggregated private cloud infrastructure as a core approach for hybrid and AI-focused enterprise workloads. The shift, led by Dell's Senior Vice President of Data Center Solutions, targets large enterprises that want more agile and scalable IT architectures. items.title: How Much Upside Can AAPL Stock's Growth Deliver?
items.summary: At $314.58, Apple (AAPL) looks set up for roughly 38% of upside over the next three years under a conservative scenario. Not a moonshot, but enough to matter if the math holds. Revenue compounding does all the work, because the scenario holds the multiple flat at today's level rather than assuming any re-rating. Here is the operational reality the math is built on.
